opennyai_summary.decision:
1. This order shall dispose of the aforementioned 24 writ petitions as common issue is involved therein.
2. The challenge in the present petition is to the order dated 31.03.2017 & 11.04.2017 (Annexures P-22 & P-23) whereby under Section 101 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013, the acquisition proceedings as such pertaining to the notification under Section 4 & 6 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894, dated 12.08.2009 and 11.08.2010, respectively, followed by the Award, dated 06.08.2012 had been nullified.
3.
In CWP-10259-2017, titled Mohammad Mamman vs. State of Haryana & others, and other connected matters, we have already allowed the writ petitions, vide detailed order dated 27.09.2024 and the matters are thus, squarely covered by the reasons given in the said order.
Accordingly, the present petitions are also disposed of in the same terms.
5. Pending miscellaneous application (s), if any, shall also stand disposed of.
